alt: 兩位好友同時拿出送給對方的小盆栽，相視微笑。
scene_prompt: Two close friends at a craft table smile knowingly at one another: each has independently brought a small potted seedling and reaches to give it to the other at the same time. Their matching thoughtful gifts and warm eye contact show mutual understanding without speaking. Two distinct plants, natural anatomy, no heart icons or writing.
